This program reads the text from standard input and runs each `name <- value;` line in order. It skips any line starting with `//`, so the "stale log" lines are never executed. Any other line that is not an assignment, such as the instructions around the listing, is ignored.

```python
import sys
import re

def main():
    text = sys.stdin.read()
    env = {}
    pat = re.compile(r'^\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*<-\s*(-?\d+|[A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*;\s*$')
    for line in text.splitlines():
        s = line.strip()
        if not s or s.startswith('//') or s.startswith('#'):
            continue
        m = pat.match(s)
        if not m:
            continue
        target, src = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        if re.fullmatch(r'-?\d+', src):
            val = int(src)
        else:
            val = env.get(src, 0)
        env[target] = val
    a = env.get('a', 0)
    b = env.get('b', 0)
    t = env.get('TMP', 0)
    print(f"a ?= {a}; b ?= {b}; TMP ?= {t};")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
